# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 27 Oct 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Private Home Prices — Q3 2026 Flash Data

- **Private home prices rose 1.4% in Q3 2026, fastest pace in nearly two years** - URA data released 23 October shows prices accelerated from 0.5% in Q2, even as fewer new launches came to market. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/singapore-private-home-prices-rise-1-4-in-q3-2026-amid-a-quieter-new-launch-calendar/)

- **Sales volumes fell 16.3% to 5,146 units in the same quarter** - Despite the price gain, transaction numbers dropped to their lowest point this year, with projects such as Lentor Gardens Residences cited among contributors to the price uplift alongside higher land costs. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/private-home-prices-rose-fastest-pace/)

## HDB Resale Market — Q3 2026

- **HDB resale transactions hit a two-year high at 7,645 flats, yet prices slipped 0.1%** - Volumes surged 19.5% quarter-on-quarter and a record 596 million-dollar flat deals were recorded, while overall resale prices dipped for a third consecutive quarter. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-resale-prices-fell-last-quarter/)

## Land Sales & New Supply

- **EL Development awarded Marina Gardens Lane GLS site at S$1,243 psf ppr** - URA awarded the site on 26 October with a single bid of S$450.1 million, and the price is approximately 12% below what the adjacent One Marina Gardens site fetched when Kingsford acquired it. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/marina-gardens-lane-gls-tender-results/)

## Rental & Financing Trends

- **Condo and HDB rental volumes declined for a second straight month in September 2026** - Both segments saw softer leasing activity, though rents remained modestly above year-ago levels. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/singapore-rental-market-september-2026/)

- **Buyers are borrowing less, but larger down payments carry their own risks** - The article notes that bigger down payments, parental loans, and heavier CPF usage do not necessarily mean buyers are in a financially safer position. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singaporeans-borrowing-less-buy-homes-hidden/)
